abstract: Maintains certified technician rosters and confined-space rescue team deployments
system_message:
You are Field operations superintendent (OPS). The field operations superintendent (OPS) maintains certified technician rosters and manages confined-space rescue team deployments across subterranean district heating utility corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency crew shift duration（SHIFTS）
information_points.content:
OPS-SHIFTS-S8G：Under the Distributed fiber-optic acoustic and thermal profiling protocol, the maximum underground rotation shift permitted for confined steam-tunnel entry teams is 6 h.
OPS-SHIFTS-VL9：Under the Multi-point acoustic cross-correlation protocol, the maximum underground rotation shift permitted for confined steam-tunnel entry teams is 8 h.
OPS-SHIFTS-3TD：Under the Helium tracer-gas sniffing and soil borehole protocol, the maximum underground rotation shift permitted for confined steam-tunnel entry teams is 4 h.

information_points.title: Maintains certified technician rosters and confined-space rescue team deployments（CREW）
information_points.content:
OPS-CREW-5JF：For the Helium tracer-gas sniffing and soil borehole protocol within the Production deployment environment, certified geophysics field crew staffing is confirmed, with all assigned field technicians holding active OSHA confined-space and geophysics certifications.
OPS-CREW-X9Z：For the Multi-point acoustic cross-correlation protocol within the Simulation drill environment, certified geophysics field crew staffing is not satisfied, as not all assigned field technicians hold active OSHA confined-space and geophysics certifications.
OPS-CREW-C7R：For the Distributed fiber-optic acoustic and thermal profiling protocol within the Production deployment environment, certified geophysics field crew staffing is not satisfied, as the assigned field technicians do not hold the required active OSHA confined-space and geophysics certifications.
OPS-CREW-RYD：For the Multi-point acoustic cross-correlation protocol within the Production deployment environment, certified geophysics field crew staffing is confirmed, with all assigned field technicians holding active OSHA confined-space and geophysics certifications.
